title: Edited RichTextLabel text property is not shown in editor and with get_text()
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.3.stable.official.77dcf97d8

### System information

Win11

### Issue description

I have found a couple similar but not exact reports in regards to RTL and its text content, so I'm not sure if it's how it's supposed to be. 

I created a couple RTLs at runtime and filled them with text and bbcode tags. Then made a function to dynamically remove specific tags. There were some problems and when trying to debug it I noticed that there is no output when calling for/.checking RTL's `text`. Neither in Editor nor in `print()`

RTL nodes are added as children in my project, so they are physically present on the screen, and I can see that changing the contents or RTL at runtime actually works. I just can't debug it/get the text value of them to show properly outside of the RTL nodes themself.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a RTL in code/at runtime
2. Append some text or change it through text property
3. Add `print()` to show RTL.text or `RTL.get_text()` or `RTL.get_parsed_text()`
4. Add Debug points to that code
5. Check the text property of the RTL while debugging + the `print` result

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```
var RTL = RichTextLabel.new()
RTL.append_text("TESTING")
print(RTL.text)
```
